name: search_files
description:
Search plain-text files by content inside registered source directories, similar to a safe rg/ripgrep query. Use this when you need to find exact text, phrases, or regex patterns in local files before reading or editing them. For coding/codebase browsing, use this as the default first pass to locate declarations, usages, imports, tests, configuration keys, error text, TODOs, or implementation seams, then follow up with read_file/read_files only for the relevant matched paths or line ranges. In restricted mode, searches are limited to the current registered source scope; allow-all/non-restricted permission modes can search all registered sources, and open mode can search an explicitly supplied absolute local path.

This tool searches file contents, not the indexed knowledge base. Use search_knowledge_base first for evidence retrieval across indexed documents; use search_files when you need source-local text locations, line numbers, or files that may not be indexed yet.

query.description: Literal text or regex pattern to search for

path.description: Optional file or directory path to search. If omitted, searches all directories in the current source scope.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression instead of literal text (default false)

include_globs.description: Optional glob patterns to include, such as *.md or notes/**/*.txt

exclude_globs.description: Optional glob patterns to exclude, such as **/archive/**

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return (default 50, max 200)

context_lines.description: Number of surrounding lines to include before and after each match (default 0, max 3)

include_hidden.description: Include dotfiles and hidden directories (default false)
